response.draft:
Slide 1: Ridgeline Return Works
Paid work, permanent jobs and support for people coming home from prison and jail
Carver Falls, Tamsen County
A request to the Pellwood Foundation: $90,000 toward our FY2027 expansion

Slide 2: Two Years of Growth
People enrolled: 88 in FY2025 → 121 in FY2026 (+38%)
Placed in permanent jobs: 47 → 69 (+47%)
Average starting wage: $17.10 → $18.25
Employers hiring our participants: 15 → 23
State IDs or licenses obtained: 52 → 83

Slide 3: How It Works
Paid crew work within five business days of intake, at $16.50 an hour
Landscaping, light demolition and park cleanup contracts
A job coach helps with ID, a resume, a driver's license and interviews
Goal: a permanent job within 12 weeks, then 6 months of support
"The crew paid me the first week. That's the part nobody else did. I didn't have to choose between rent and showing up." — Darnell, now at Brannock Precast

Slide 4: Six-Month Job Retention
71% of FY2026 placements were still employed at six months (FY2025: 58%)
Based on the 52 of 69 placements that have reached six months; 37 confirmed employed
The 6 people we lost contact with are counted as not employed
Local unemployment also fell, from 5.1% to 4.4%
We have no comparison group and do not claim the program caused the improvement

Slide 5: What We Learned
Most job losses happen in the first 60 days after placement
People who stayed employed were far more likely to have had 3 or more coach check-ins in those 60 days
Coaches were stretched thin, and follow-up was what slipped
With one crew of 12, people referred in busy months waited up to three weeks to start
Four employers asked for more referrals than we could send

Slide 6: The FY2027 Expansion: $186,000
Second crew lead and crew supervisor stipend: $72,000
Dedicated retention coach, full-time with benefits: $64,000
Second crew vehicle lease and equipment: $28,000
Added participant supports for the larger cohort: $22,000

Slide 7: FY2027 Targets
Enroll 160 people
Place 90 in permanent jobs
Raise six-month retention to 75%
Retention measured the same way as this year, with lost contacts counted as not employed

Slide 8: Our Request
$90,000 from the Pellwood Foundation, about half of the $186,000 expansion
The other $96,000 is being raised from current funders
The core FY2027 budget of $612,400 is covered by existing sources
Full FY2027 budget, including the expansion: $798,400
FY2026 cost per permanent placement: about $8,875
Contact: Marisol Okafor-Reyes, Executive Director, Ridgeline Return Works
